decisive_join: Join the richer behavioral object of an assessment center to the narrower evidence sampled by test batteries, then recover what civil-rights and disability law require and what they leave unobserved.

findings.claim: Behavioral simulations, personality inventories, aptitude tests, and instruction-following exercises sample different evaluative objects.
limits: The comparative predictive value of particular instruments remains role- and validation-specific.

findings.claim: Civil-rights law created a genuine job-relevance and adverse-impact correction without solving every individual false-negative or novelty-loss problem.
limits: Jurisdiction, protected class, disability status, instrument, and employer process matter.

findings.claim: The seed cannot establish a legal conclusion about Agoda, a missing score, or the disposition of the accommodation request.
limits: The exact score report, role model, threshold, accommodation response, and final decision rule are unavailable.

observations.notes: The seed stresses that a computerized test battery without behavioral simulation is not an assessment center.
observations.subject: professional assessment center

observations.notes: The seed supplies an explicit richer-object versus streamlined-representation table.
observations.subject: assessment compression

observations.notes: No legal conclusion about a present employer is drawn from this historical source lead.
observations.subject: Griggs
observations.value: abstract requirements with exclusionary consequences require demonstrated relation to relevant job performance

observations.notes: The seed uses additional time as an example when speed is not itself the intended construct.
observations.subject: EEOC guidance
observations.value: measure the intended job-related ability rather than an unrelated disability limitation

observations.notes: The seed contrasts this with harms that may not appear as protected-group adverse impact.
observations.subject: Uniform Guidelines
observations.value: group selection-rate impact is a principal validation trigger

observations.notes: The employer generally lacks workplace outcome labels for rejected candidates, leaving individual false negatives difficult to measure.
observations.subject: rejected candidate performance

selection_rule: Distinguish instrument validity, job relation, group impact, accommodation, and individual false negatives; never infer one from another without the required record.

prohibited_inferences: a test battery is an assessment center
absence of group adverse impact proves individual validity
an accommodation request proves unlawful handling
generic test validity proves role-specific decision validity

title: Job relevance and dimensional loss: legal correction versus compressed evidence
